title: Zesty Boiled Vietnamese Cheese Ca Kho To
description: A briny and creamy Vietnamese dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, boiled to perfection in a kadhai, and served in a ca-kho-to form, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner option.

ingredients.name: Mexican cheese
ingredients.notes: preferably a blend of cheddar and mozzarella

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality fish sauce for the best flavor

instructions: In a large kadhai, combine the water, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the shredded Mexican cheese to the kadhai and stir until it is fully melted and the mixture is smooth.
Continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly and reduced by about half.
Stir in the chopped green onions and cook for an additional minute.
Remove the kadhai from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Transfer the cheese mixture to a ca-kho-to form and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the ca-kho-to for at least 2 hours before serving.
Slice the ca-kho-to into thick rounds and serve chilled.
